svg.title: Chapter 2: Torchlight
svg.desc: Chapter 2's card in charcoal: the night road from above with one amber circle of torchlight holding post 14 and its fire ring, a dim post behind, and bare forest floor ahead where the road narrows. Beside the picture, the map's green legend box keeps its height with 8 of its nine rows printed; Tam's pencil count underneath agrees.
